name: discord-message-builder
description: A full-featured Discord message builder website (Discohook + discord-webhook style) with a bot interaction/action system.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client,bot -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client" "npm:dev:bot"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n client,server,bot -c magenta,blue,green "npm:build:client" "npm:build:server" "npm:build:bot"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
